title: Wood Frogs Survive With 65% Of Body Water Frozen
hook: Wood frogs survive ice levels that kill most vertebrates.
closing: Their biology shows how life can endure extreme cold without exaggerating what freezes.
question: Would you survive that winter?

segments.say: Wood frogs survive with 65% of body water frozen. Most vertebrates die at far lower levels.
Wood frogs survive 16 degrees below freezing, far colder than a typical frog can tolerate.
Wood frogs reach 68 degrees latitude in Alaska. Freeze tolerance lets them live far beyond most frogs.
